item_leather_armor_of_gleaming.name: Leather Armor of Gleaming
item_leather_armor_of_gleaming.description:
Common Magic Item
Light armor of AC 11 + Dex modifier

The breastplate and shoulder protectors of this armor are made of leather that has been stiffened by being boiled in oil. The rest of the armor is made of softer and more flexible materials.
item_leather_armor_of_gleaming.magicEffect: This armor can never get dirty.
